title: The Cave That Kept Growing Tongues
story: Gorrelmaw the Cavern Mouth blocks the only tunnel out of the crystal mines with 30 sticky tongues. Every time Mr 6 gently ties one tongue into a bow, that tongue stops moving — but 2 brand-new tongues sprout somewhere else in the cave. Mr 6 ties 12 tongues in a row while the miners watch nervously.
question: After Mr 6 ties 12 tongues (each tie removes 1 active tongue but sprouts 2 new ones), how many active tongues does Gorrelmaw have?
hint: Each tie changes the count by minus one plus two — figure out the net change per tie, then multiply by 12.
victory: Mr 6 stopped at exactly 12, pointed out that tying more would only make things worse, and Gorrelmaw — impressed that someone finally understood him — rolled aside and let everyone stroll out.
imagePrompt: An enormous cave-mouth monster with dozens of long ribbony tongues tied into neat bows, glittering crystal walls, miners peeking from behind a boulder, a caped numeral six mid-knot.
solution: Each tie changes the count by -1 + 2 = +1 tongue.
After 12 ties the change is 12 × 1 = +12 tongues.
praise: Tracking what each tie does was exactly the right strategy - the missing step was combining the -1 and +2 into a net gain of 1.
